description: This file declares utility functions for encoding and decoding structures related to Certificate Transparency, including SignedCertificateTimestamp, MerkleTreeLeaf, and SignedTreeHead, used in TLS wire format encoding.

methods.name: EncodeDigitallySigned
methods.description: Encodes a DigitallySigned structure into a string if signature data length is within limit.

methods.name: DecodeDigitallySigned
methods.description: Decodes a DigitallySigned object from input string.

methods.name: EncodeSignedEntry
methods.description: Encodes SignedEntryData into a string, ensuring size constraints.

methods.name: EncodeTreeLeaf
methods.description: Serializes a MerkleTreeLeaf into a string.

methods.name: EncodeV1SCTSignedData
methods.description: Encodes data signed by an SCT, including timestamp, log entry, and extensions.

methods.name: EncodeTreeHeadSignature
methods.description: Encodes a SignedTreeHead into a string for signature verification.

methods.name: DecodeSCTList
methods.description: Decodes a list of SCTs from a string.

methods.name: DecodeSignedCertificateTimestamp
methods.description: Decodes a single SCT from input string.

methods.name: EncodeSignedCertificateTimestamp
methods.description: Serializes an SCT into a string.

methods.name: EncodeSCTListForTesting
methods.description: Encodes an SCT list for testing purposes.
